test_title: PYST 68: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:

The documents have been being reviewed by the compliance team for several weeks.

options.text: The compliance team has reviewed the documents for weeks.
The compliance team has been reviewing the documents for several weeks.
The documents were being reviewed for several weeks.
The compliance team had reviewed the documents weekly.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Active voice structure: The agent of the passive voice sentence (introduced by "by") becomes the subject of the active voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The documents have been being reviewed by the compliance team for several weeks."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the agent "The compliance team" at the beginning as the new subject.
 
• Change the passive verb form "have been being reviewed" (present perfect continuous passive) to "has been reviewing" (present perfect continuous active). We use "has" because "compliance team" acts as a singular collective noun.
 
• Place the original subject "the documents" after the verb as the new object, and retain the time phrase "for several weeks."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The compliance team has been reviewing the documents for several weeks."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The compliance team has reviewed the documents for weeks." – Incorrect tense (present perfect active) and alters the time phrase.
 
• **Option 3: **"The documents were being reviewed for several weeks." – Incorrect voice (this remains in the passive voice) and incorrect tense (past continuous).
 
• **Option 4: **"The compliance team had reviewed the documents weekly." – Incorrect tense (past perfect active) and alters the meaning of the frequency/duration.
